skill.summary: Isolated Kali Linux sandbox for running pentest tools and risky commands safely.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of prts-sandbox skill.
- Provides an isolated Kali Linux 2025.4 container to safely run pentest tools and risky commands.
- Includes CLI script (~/.openclaw/skills/prts-sandbox/scripts/sandbox-cmd.sh) for managing the sandbox: status, start, stop, reset, and exec.
- Details when to use the sandbox vs host, troubleshooting steps, and available pentest tools (nmap, hydra, sqlmap, etc.).
- Adds quick reference and critical rules for safe usage.
